content.title: Stocks waver, Tesla Model 3 probe, Coupang stock jumps
content.description:
Some of the stories that Wall Street is watching on December 26 include: 

The major averages are wavering between gains and losses (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC). 

The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is looking into door handle issues on some Tesla (TSLA) Model 3's. 

Shares of Coupang (CPNG) are surging after the company said a recent data breach wasn't as bad as feared.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
